_comment: Generated apps from create-blocks-app templates in git history, for the blocks migrate tests. <template>@<commit>: aws-blocks/scripts/, index.cdk.ts, cdk.json and package.json of that template at that commit (amplify: the scripts create-blocks-app added).

packageJson.name: blocks-app
packageJson.blocksTemplateDescription: Vite + lit-html frontend with auth, DynamoDB, and realtime (safe default)

packageJson.name: blocks-api-only-app
packageJson.blocksTemplateDescription: Headless JSON API service — public health check + auth-gated CRUD, no frontend (build for a mobile/CLI/3rd-party client)

packageJson.name: blocks-nextjs-app
packageJson.blocksTemplateDescription: Next.js 16 App Router with Server + Client Components calling Blocks

scripts.sandbox: cross-env NODE_OPTIONS="--conditions=cdk" AMPLIFY_SANDBOX=true npx ampx sandbox
scripts.sandbox:delete: cross-env NODE_OPTIONS="--conditions=cdk" npx ampx sandbox delete --yes
